name: seemore-skill
description: Turn a folder of Markdown into a documentation site by asking an AI agent — install, scaffold, write, preview, build and publish, with no terminal commands to run yourself.

plugins.name: seemore
plugins.description: Set up and run seemore for someone who would rather describe what they want than run install commands. Scaffolds a docs folder, writes and edits pages, starts a live preview, builds a static site, and publishes it to a live URL.
